PSY101, Abq1
teaching:
teaches in an extremely fun and engaging way, i have never once been bored during his lectures. explains concepts in a simple, easy to understand and clear way using examples and interactive techniques like making students measure their level of stress, showing videos, etc.
his slides are one of the best i’ve came across so far, very well written and just studying from the slides are enough.
grading:
he's pretty lenient and fair in terms of grading.
for quizzes, it's purely objective (MCQs and True/False). questions are conceptual and don't always come directly from the slides, they're example based. however, it'll always come from topics that have been discussed. best 2 out of 3 taken.
for mids/finals, there's both objective questions and broad questions. the broad questions are super easy to get good marks in, if you're able to explain properly and provide examples, you need to answer 2 out of 3 questions. he only takes 1 mid.
there's no presentations. he takes a viva before finals, which is extremely easy and is taken to see what you've understood from the course. he'll let you choose a chapter and ask you questions from that chapter and sometimes ask you to connect concepts from two different chapters.
there's also an individual assignment, given to assess your overall understanding of the whole course. he'll give all the instructions and guide you.
full marks given for attendance if you have 93% attendance.
he'll give suggestions and tips before exams.
extra:
he's extremely approachable and very student- friendly. he loves when students ask questions.
he asks questions in class directly from the slides by calling out names of students and if you're able to answer correctly, he'll mark it (which might be used for participation marks).
he's extremely punctual, never been late to class in the entire semester — and very organized, his course outline has all the dates and syllabus written for quizzes, mids, viva and he tries to follow the calendar as much as possible.
he's very considerate too, he has changed dates of quizzes multiple times because 3-4 students had more than 1 quizzes/mids on the same day and he didn't want to give too much pressure.
there's just no way you'll get a bad grade under him, if you're attending classes regularly, have a clear understanding of the concepts and put genuine effort.
overall, he truly knows how to make a class engaging and fun and is an excellent teacher.
